coverage.excluded_results: Exclude white-box matrix diagonals, white-box attack performance, accuracy-distortion/CLEVER analyses, examples and WordNet distance plots. f1.evidence: Separate top-1/top-5 benchmark clean accuracies are listed for all 18 models, each used as source and target. These are not necessarily accuracies on the filtered attack cohort.

f2.evidence: Paper wording establishes source-clean selection, not explicit target-clean selection. The released evaluator explicitly skips target-clean mistakes before incrementing img_no. Preserve this positive code evidence separately; paper-to-code correspondence for all panels remains unresolved.

f3.evidence: The paper explicitly includes successful and failed source attacks when computing transferability; the released evaluator also retains source failures.

f4.evidence: Nominal 1,000-image sample size does not determine surviving pair denominators. Rounded heatmaps do not establish unique original counts. Newly generated per-example outputs are not original published counts.

f5.evidence: FGSM/I-FGSM numerical L-infinity budgets are explicit. C&W/EAD confidence kappa is not an L2/L-infinity radius; these minimum-distortion formulations do not supply an analogous stated numerical radius across all groups.

f6.locator: Pinned release README, original model/attack/evaluator code; recomputation/su18_original/README.md
f6.evidence: Downloaded and hashed released model/data archives, and executed unchanged TensorFlow 1.8 attack/model classes for FGSM Inception-v1 to Inception-v2, epsilon 0.1. This meets the existence criterion for a selected configuration, not full-paper replication or established historical seed/objective correspondence.

operational_findings.target_clean_filter: yes: test_transferability.py skips target_original_class_label != argmax(true_label) before img_no increments
operational_findings.source_success_filter: no: source failure status is not used to remove attempted attacks
operational_findings.coverage: Code inspection plus one untargeted same-size model pair executed; not all published configurations.

bounds_checks.reason: Do not subtract benchmark clean error from source-filtered or target-clean-filtered rates. The operational evaluator has zero baseline target error on its clean-correct denominator by construction. Its mapping to every published panel is not established, so no new published-value bound is added.
Top-5 target-label matching is not untargeted misclassification probability; do not apply the classification error bound.

limitations: Non-blind evidence audit; no independent agreement estimate.
Selected rerun establishes executable artifacts, not complete original-table replication. Published seed and objective branch remain unresolved.
Dimension-changing comparisons require reconciling paper white-border wording with released zero padding on [-0.5,0.5]. Selected same-size pair avoids this ambiguity.
